title.zh: ARK Launches Tokenized Venture Fund on Ethereum With $500 Minimum
title.en: ARK Launches Tokenized Venture Fund on Ethereum With $500 Minimum

current_state.zh: ARK Invest已通过Securitize在以太坊上将其13亿美元的ARK Venture Fund（ARKVX）代币化，该基金持有OpenAI、Anthropic和Stripe等仓位；美国零售投资者可以500美元最低门槛参与，流动性限于季度回购要约。
current_state.en: ARK Invest has tokenized its $1.3 billion ARK Venture Fund (ARKVX) on Ethereum via Securitize, with holdings including OpenAI, Anthropic and Stripe; US retail investors can access it with a $500 minimum, with liquidity limited to quarterly repurchase offers.
